text:
Ash (product): Quick ask — can we surface a compact "slim" cost card that shows per-route token burn + cache savings (24h) with an SLO hit/latency overlay? Exec wants a one-line answer tomorrow morning.
Marta (telemetry): Do you mean raw token counts or normalized unit-cost? sampling matters for accuracy. we can approximate with sampled paths but need to surface confidence. :thinking_face:
Sam (frontend): UI note — space is tight on the dashboard. propose: small sparkline for cost, percent change badge, and an expand modal for breakdown. toggle between 'token' and 'net-cost' modes.
Kevin (infra): Also need to decide if cache savings are attributed to route or to prefetch pool. shared prefetch makes attribution fuzzy.
Ash (product): Normalized unit-cost would be ideal (token * model_sku_price - cache_credit). Confidence % is fine. pref is route attribution first.
Marta (telemetry): I can emit a derived metric "net_token_cost_per_route" but it needs a join across events: invocation, model_sku, cache_hit. sampling rate currently 1/100 for a lot of routes. I can run a short reingest for the last 24h for the demo if infra agrees.
Kevin (infra): Reingest ok for small window. watch CPU on the batch pipeline. If we need realtime-ish (minutes) we should compute a rolling estimate in the router and export a gauge. That avoids a heavy backfill.
Sam (frontend): For the prototype I'll wire the card to two endpoints: /api/costs/route_summary and /api/costs/route_detail. Example payload we expect:
```json
{
  "route": "embed-user-profile",
  "period": "24h",
  "tokens": 1234567,
  "cache_savings": 0.12,
  "net_cost": 45.67,
  "confidence": 0.94
}
```
Marta (telemetry): That looks fine. I'll add confidence and a sample_count field. Also returning a provenance tag: "estimation" vs "exact".
Kevin (infra): Implementation plan: add router gauge (per-route) emitting tokens and cache_hits every minute (prometheus-ish). aggregator job reduces to the API store. fallback to sampled reingest if gauge missing.
Ash (product): Acceptance criteria for demo: card shows route name, net cost (USD), sparkline, cache % saved, confidence badge, and a tooltip explaining attribution caveats. If we have time, add per-model breakdown inside modal.
Marta (telemetry): I'll prototype the API and push a small dataset for the demo. FYI: we should flag routes with <100 samples as "low confidence".
Sam (frontend): Will mock the card and wire to a feature flag. Can we reuse the existing small KPI widget? saves dev time.
Kevin (infra): I'll add a lightweight router gauge and a small cron job to aggregate into a low-latency store. estimate: 1 engineer day + 0.5 infra ops for staging rollout.
ci-bot: build/preview for dashboard-stub succeeded — https://staging.ci.redwood/dashboard/preview/6462123456 :white_check_mark:
Ash (product): Nice. Marta/Kevin/Sam — can we scope this into a 2-day spike? if so I'll block time in tomorrow's planning and present the demo.
Marta (telemetry): 2-day spike works if we do estimation-first and skip full backfill. will prepare sample payloads.
Sam (frontend): ok. I'll make the mock and the modal prototype today.
Kevin (infra): I'll stand up the gauge and small aggregator in staging.
Ash (product): Thanks — tagging for visibility: @marta @sam @kevin. We'll sync in 2 hours for quick handoff. :rocket:
